confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge targeting July 2026 peak-season prices, not checked against live menus, listings or booking sites. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is least certain because July rates vary widely by area, lead time and demand. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor (about 1.7x and 0.9x) because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. The FX observation came from RBA exchange-rates pages surfaced in search results.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Rome as a high-demand Italian tourist city, benchmarked against other large Italian and Western European capitals with similar July peak-season demand; no live listings consulted.
